catalog.title: The catalog
catalog.description: Everything written for this academy, and how much of it students can reach.
catalog.buried_hint_one: {{count}} exercise is set to show, but a lecture, module, or course above it is hidden. Students cannot open it.
catalog.buried_hint_other: {{count}} exercises are set to show, but a lecture, module, or course above them is hidden. Students cannot open them.
catalog.shelved_one: {{count}} visible course is not assigned to any class
catalog.shelved_other: {{count}} visible courses are not assigned to any class

first_course.title: Start here
first_course.body: A course holds the modules, lectures, and exercises your classes learn. Everything else on this page starts describing itself once one exists.

blockers.title: Needs fixing
blockers.description: Defects only you can clear, most consequential first.
blockers.empty_body: Every visible course has content, every live exercise can be graded, and every active class has a teacher and something to learn.

hidden_course_assigned.title: Class assigned a hidden course
hidden_course_assigned.body: The class is running, but the course is hidden, so there is nothing for students to open. Show the course, or assign a different one.

empty_visible_course.title: Visible course with no exercises
empty_visible_course.body: Students can open the course and find nothing inside. Add exercises, or hide the course until it is ready.

ungradeable_exercise.title: Exercise that cannot be graded
ungradeable_exercise.body: The exercise is live with no hidden test cases, so a student can pass it without solving it. Add at least one hidden case.

unfinished_exercise.title: Exercise with no description
unfinished_exercise.body: The exercise is live and says nothing about what to solve. Write the description, or hide it until you have.

class_without_teacher.title: Class with no teacher
class_without_teacher.body: Nobody is responsible for this class and nobody can monitor it. Assign a teacher.

class_teacher_unavailable.title: Class teacher unavailable
class_teacher_unavailable.body: The assigned teacher's account is suspended, removed, or no longer a teacher here. Replace them, or clear the assignment.

class_without_course.title: Class with no course
class_without_course.body: The class exists and has nothing to learn. Assign at least one course.

changes.title: Recent changes
changes.description: Who changed what, and whether students were watching when it happened.
changes.empty_body: Edits to courses, lectures, and exercises appear here as soon as somebody makes one.

problems.title: Hardest problems
problems.description: The exercises students are least able to solve, across every class.
problems.empty_body: Once students have attempted enough exercises in this period, the hardest of them appear here.

calibration.title: Difficulty labels that no longer fit
calibration.description: Exercises whose measured solve rate contradicts the label you gave them.
calibration.empty_body: No exercise with enough attempts is solved at a rate its difficulty label rules out.

grind.title: Solved by brute force
grind.description: Exercises students do pass, but only after many tries — usually an unclear description or a test case that disagrees with it.
grind.empty_body: Where students are solving exercises, they are getting there in a reasonable number of attempts.

never_attempted.title: Live but untouched
never_attempted.description: Exercises in front of active students that nobody has opened in this period.
never_attempted.empty_body: Every visible exercise in a course with active students has at least one attempt in this period.

reach.title: Course reach
reach.description: How far each course travels, and where students stop.
reach.empty_body: Course reach appears once this academy has a course.
reach.truncated: Only the first 100 courses are shown.

unavailable.page_title: The curriculum overview could not be loaded
unavailable.page_body: The academy's own totals could not be read, so nothing below them can be trusted either.
unavailable.section_body: This section could not be measured. Everything else on the page is current.

roster.title: Classes and people
roster.description: Who teaches this curriculum, and how many students it reaches.
roster.truncated: Only the first 50 classes are shown.
roster.empty_body: A class is where a course meets students. Arrange one, assign a teacher, and the curriculum above starts reaching somebody.
